# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 50 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth Writes the Tablets

---

**50:1** And Seth wrote upon tablets of stone and tablets of clay all the words of his father and mother and all their deeds.

**50:2** And he wrote of the creation of the world and of the fall in paradise, and of the penance of Adam and Eve, and of the hope of the resurrection.

**50:3** And he kept these tablets in a safe place, saying: 'These shall be found in the last days.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
